verdict.rationale: Wrike documents its own two-way sync with 22 external systems, including Jira and GitHub, plus personalized dashboards. Together these imply that synced external tasks could be viewed inside Wrike, but no evidence shows an aggregated 'my assigned tasks across tools' view. Missing for 10: an explicit unified cross-tool view of assigned tasks, a list of which project management tools beyond Jira are supported, details on how assignee mapping works across tools, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can see my assigned tasks from multiple project management tools in one unified view

citations.quote: Set up two-way syncs between your Wrike account and 22 integrated systems, including Jira, GitHub, and more.
Configure and tailor personalized dashboard to help track the work you need to see.
